script.title: कबीर के नाम की सौ कविताएँ, असली शायद सिर्फ़ छह
script.hook_text: कबीर के दोहे लिखे नहीं गए
sentences: संत कबीर के दोहे लिखे नहीं गए थे, बोले गए थे।
पंद्रहवीं सदी में वाराणसी में जन्मे कबीर जी, स्वामी रामानंद के शिष्य माने जाते हैं।
उनकी बानियाँ सत्रहवीं सदी तक मुँह-ज़बानी ही आगे बढ़ती रहीं।
रास्ते में दोहे बदले, और अनजान लोगों ने नए दोहे जोड़कर कबीर के नाम कर दिए।
विद्वान कहते हैं कि ये बेईमानी नहीं, कबीर के लिए इज़्ज़त थी।
1915 में टैगोर ने सौ कविताओं का अंग्रेज़ी संग्रह छापा, सॉन्ग्स ऑफ़ कबीर।
एक आलोचक, वी. सी. मिश्र, का कहना है कि उनमें से सिर्फ़ छह ही असली हैं।
आपका पसंदीदा कबीर का दोहा सच में उनका है, या किसी चाहने वाले का?
scenes: Extreme close-up of Sant Kabir's face, an elderly 15th-century weaver-poet with a white beard and simple cap, eyes closed in rapture as he sings aloud, warm lamplight on his skin.
Young Kabir in a simple cotton dhoti bowing at the feet of Swami Ramananda on the steps of a ghat in 15th-century Varanasi, dawn mist over the Ganga, reverent expressions, medium shot.
A village gathering under a banyan tree in old north India, a wandering singer with an ektara reciting verses while villagers listen with rapt attention, dusty golden afternoon light, wide shot.
A chain of singers across generations in medieval India passing songs from mouth to ear, travelling minstrels at a fire, faces animated as they improvise, warm firelight, medium wide shot.
Humble devotees in old north India singing with folded hands before a simple loom where Kabir once sat, faces full of love and respect, soft morning light through a doorway, medium shot.

Rabindranath Tagore, white-bearded in a long robe, writing at a wooden desk in 1915 Bengal with a quill, a stack of manuscript pages beside him, thoughtful expression, warm window light, medium close-up.

An elderly Indian scholar in spectacles and kurta sitting among piles of old palm-leaf and paper manuscripts, frowning sceptically as he compares pages, dim study lit by a single lamp, close medium shot.
Sant Kabir sitting at his loom in a sunlit Varanasi courtyard, gently smiling with a knowing look, threads glowing in the light, a mysterious peaceful mood, medium shot.
script.description:
कबीर के दोहे सदियों तक सिर्फ़ ज़ुबानी चले।
टैगोर की सौ कविताओं में असली कितनी?
claims_en: Kabir's poems were verbally composed, not written
Kabir lived in the 15th century and was born in Varanasi
Kabir is believed to have been a disciple of Swami Ramananda
His poems were transmitted viva voce through the 17th century
Over time poems changed and unknown authors inserted new couplets attributed to Kabir
Scholars say this was not dishonesty but out of respect for him
Tagore's English translation and compilation Songs of Kabir was first published in 1915 and has a hundred poems
Critic V.C. Mishra suggested only six of its hundred poems are authentic
